1  Special Tahsildar, Land Acquisition NH Unit II Neyyattinkara, Keral  by considering the representation of the petitioner dated 10.12.201  For Petitioner : Mr.S.Siva Thilakar  For R1 to R3 : Mrs.D.Farjana Ghoushia  Special Government Plea  For R4 : Mr.S.Sankarapandian  for M/s.C.Arul Vadivel   ORDER
The petitioner seeks a direction for payment of just compensation for the acquisition of land bearing Survey No.71/15, Medhukummal Village.

2.The learned Special Government Pleader for the respondents 1 to 3 submits, on instructions, that the sums of Rs.4,41,548/- (Rupees Four Lakhs Forty One Thousand Five Hundred and Forty Eight Only) and Rs.
5,10,460/- (Rupees Five Lakhs Ten Thousand Four Hundred and Sixty Only) were paid to the petitioner by way of compensation.
3.In the counter affidavit filed by the 4th respondent
, in paragraph No.9, it is stated that the petitioner should approach the District Collector, who is the designated arbitrator, if the petitioner intends to assail the amount awarded as compensation.

4.Since the District Collector is the designated arbitrator under the National Highways Act, as submitted by the 4th respondent, the petitioner should approach the District Collector, if aggrieved by the fixation of compensation.
5.By leaving it open to the petitioner to approach the District Collector, W.P.(MD)No.3950 of 2016 is disposed of without any order as to costs.
Consequently, connected W.M.P.(MD)No.3534 of 2016 is closed.
